name: Baby In Yellow - Scary Games-Horror Game
summary:
Think babysitting is easy? Think again and try Baby In Yellow - Scary Games-Horror Game.

Enter a terrifying VR horror experience where taking care of a mysterious baby turns into a night you will never forget.

As the babysitter, you must look after the baby, complete your tasks, explore the creepy house, and uncover the strange events happening around you. What starts as a normal night quickly becomes a frightening horror experience.

Stay alert. Explore every room. Complete your objectives. And whatever
